visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed background photo with overlaid H1, short tagline lines and a CTA button on the left; product logo and price seal images on the right (stacked below on mobile).
contentPattern: Row 1: background picture. Row 2: H1, paragraph lines, CTA link. Row 3 (optional): aside pictures (product logo, price seal).
usage: Service sale page hero (Seguro Protege Casa: 'A chave quebrou? O cano vazou? ...', 'Ver planos' CTA, Protege Casa logo and 'A partir de R$ 24,90 por mes' seal).
reuseGuidance: Use for product/service landing heroes with a background photo and brand/price artwork. Rows are detected by content: the first image-only cell is the background, text cells form the copy, remaining images become the aside. Omit row 3 for a text-only overlay.
